The row's version 'rtx-pro-6000' is the hardware identity (hardware.name 'RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation'), not a copied release identifier, so version_status 'published' (defined as the version copying a published release identifier) is unsupported; 'snapshot' with a snapshot-<date> identity is the indicated word.
findings.repair: Set version_status to 'snapshot' and version to a dated identity 'snapshot-2026-11-15'; or, if a maintainer release identifier is identified, copy it into version and cite it for 'published'.
